description: This source file defines a custom Swing button class 'PopupMenuButton' that encapsulates a button which, when clicked, shows or hides an associated JPopupMenu. It manages focus and component events to control popup visibility and logs state changes for debugging.

classes.name: PopupMenuButton
classes.description: A custom JButton that toggles a JPopupMenu display on click, with focus and component event handling to track visibility and user interactions.

methods.name: PopupMenuButton
methods.description: Constructor initializing the button with text and associated popup menu, setting up event listeners for focus, component visibility, and button actions.
